batch: Western Cape murders, batch 2 (reports published 1-18 Oct 2026), hand-checked 18 Oct 2026
rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Incident date kept apart from report date. Pin = the place the source gives; 'approx.' in the title when only a street, suburb or area is known. Sources that reuse one report or one police statement are not independent corroboration.

held_back.reason: Only one source (Daily Voice, 7 Oct). It says the killing came 'hours later' than a Tuesday 23:06 shooting but also 'at about 7.30am, yesterday', so the incident date (6 or 7 Oct) cannot be fixed. Needs a second report.

signals.content: Police say a 43-year-old man sitting in a white Hyundai truck was pulled out by two men and shot dead in front of a premises on Trampoline Street, Beacon Valley, at 11:10 on Thursday 1 October; the suspects took his firearm and fled towards Hengelaar Road (Plainsman, quoting police spokesperson FC van Wyk).

checked.location: Trampoline Street, Beacon Valley (exact spot not given). The pin is the middle of the street, which OpenStreetMap places on the Eastridge side of Beacon Valley.
